articles.title: When Should You Change Your Mattress? 5 Signs It Needs Replacement
articles.description:
A comfortable and supportive bed plays an important role in getting a good night's sleep. While people often pay attention to bedsheets, pillows and overall cleanliness, the mattress itself is sometimes overlooked. Many people continue using the same mattress for years without checking its condition. However, regular use can gradually affect its support and comfort. So, how long should a mattress ideally last, and what signs indicate that it is time for a replacement? A mattress generally has an estimated lifespan of around 7 to 10 years, although this can vary depending on its quality, construction, usage, care and other factors. A mattress used every day may gradually lose its support as its foam, springs or other materials wear down.

Signs Your Mattress Is Worn Out

One of the clearest signs is an uneven or sagging surface. If a visible depression develops in the middle or another part of the mattress, it may indicate that the internal materials have lost their ability to provide proper support. If you feel as though your body is sinking into one area or the mattress no longer feels level when you lie down, it may be time to consider a replacement.

ALSO READ | Clothes Still Have Odour After Washing? Check These 5 Things Before Changing Detergent

Body Pain After Waking Up

If you regularly wake up with stiffness or discomfort in your back, shoulders or neck, your mattress could be one factor. A mattress that has become too soft, uneven or worn may not provide the support your body needs while sleeping. However, persistent or unexplained pain can have several causes, so it should not automatically be attributed to the mattress.

Is Your Mattress Making Noise?

Spring mattresses can become noisier as their internal components age. If you notice persistent creaking, squeaking or other unusual sounds whenever you turn or sit on the mattress, it could be a sign of wear. Visible damage to the springs or other components is another reason to consider replacing the mattress.

ALSO READ | Buying Mawa For Sweets? 5 Simple Tricks Can Help You Spot Adulterated Khoya

When Should You Replace Your Mattress?

There is no single replacement date that applies to every mattress. While 7 to 10 years is often used as a general lifespan, the actual condition of the mattress matters more. Excessive sagging, an uneven surface, visible wear, damaged springs or a persistent loss of comfort and support are all signs that your mattress may need to be replaced. Regularly checking its condition can help ensure that your sleeping surface continues to provide adequate support and comfort.
